name: set_unit_formation
description: Set a military unit's formation directly: STANDARD, CORPS (+10 combat) or ARMY (+20 combat), bypassing the normal corps/army requirements (Nationalism/Mobilization civics, merging two units). Params: unitId (required), formation ("STANDARD"|"CORPS"|"ARMY", required), playerId (default local player). Returns formation and combat strength before/after. Runs in GameCore_Tuner via Unit:SetMilitaryFormation (Firaxis Debug/Unit.ltp 'Form Army').
lua:
local pid = P.playerId
if pid == nil then pid = Game.GetLocalPlayer() end
local alive = false
for _, id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if id == pid then alive = true end end
if not alive then emitJson({ok=false, error="player "..tostring(pid).." is not alive"}) return end
local u = Players[pid]:GetUnits():FindID(P.unitId)
if u == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="unit "..tostring(P.unitId).." not found for player "..pid}) return end
local map = { STANDARD = MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_FORMATION, CORPS = MilitaryFormationTypes.CORPS_FORMATION, ARMY = MilitaryFormationTypes.ARMY_FORMATION }
local target = map[P.formation]
if target == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="formation must be STANDARD, CORPS or ARMY"}) return end
local names = {[0]="STANDARD",[1]="CORPS",[2]="ARMY"}
local before = { formation = names[u:GetMilitaryFormation()] or u:GetMilitaryFormation(), combat = u:GetCombat() }
u:SetMilitaryFormation(target)
local after = { formation = names[u:GetMilitaryFormation()] or u:GetMilitaryFormation(), combat = u:GetCombat() }
emitJson({ok=true, unitId=P.unitId, unitType=GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType, before=before, after=after})
